verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an inference cloud, since users could have account data, usage logs, or deployed model artifacts to retrieve. The evidence pack has no documented export feature or open-format data download. The OpenAI-compatible API and no-contract pricing lower switching costs, but they are adjacent features, not a data-export capability, and zero retention means no data is stored rather than exportable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
